title: DNS delegation for aurit.us starts early
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: DNS long pole
  Scenario: Route 53 owns aurit.us
    Given aurit.us is registered at GoDaddy
    When the Route 53 hosted zone is created and GoDaddy NS are updated
    Then dig NS aurit.us returns the AWS nameservers
    And Amplify later attaches to this zone without creating a second zone
```

## Implementation brief
1. Follow docs/DNS.md.
2. `aws route53 create-hosted-zone --name aurit.us ...`
3. Update GoDaddy nameservers manually.
4. Record ROUTE53_HOSTED_ZONE_ID in AGENTS.local.md.
5. Acceptance: `dig NS aurit.us +short` shows AWS NS.
right_now_summary: Route 53 is being set up for aurit.us, with GoDaddy nameservers awaiting manual updates.
